**Paperhue 0.3.2**: on Windows and Mac you now set up every page first and
send them all with one push. Each page can also be updated or shown on its
own. The Mac gets calendar, to-do and notes pages, and the phones get two
fixes.

## What's new

### Set up everything, then push (Windows and Mac)

- Choosing photos, page kinds, backgrounds and crops, writing notes and
  choosing cards no longer sends anything. Paperhue saves your changes and
  updates the previews.
- **Push to device** sends every page in one go. The page on screen goes
  last, and pages that did not change are skipped. If the calendars can't be
  read, the calendar pages are left as they are and the rest is still sent.
- Every page has two new buttons:
  - **Update this page** sends just that page.
  - **Show on device** switches the device to that page, like pressing its
    button, without sending anything.
- Windows: **Add note** saves a note. In My cards, **Put on page N** puts a
  card on a card page. Both go to the device with the next push.

### Mac: calendar, to-do and notes pages

Each page on the Mac can now show:

- Today + month, Today + week or To-do, drawn from your calendars (the
  public Taiwan holidays calendar when none is set up);
- Notes board or Big message, with the notes you write.

**Sync now** updates the calendar pages. The daily schedule stays off until
you add a time. The Day and Month pages and cards come to the Mac in a later
version.

### Phones

- A page set to Photo can now be given a photo and sent from **Pages**.
  Before, it had nothing to send.
- A new **Log** section at the bottom has a **Copy log** button. If a page
  ever looks wrong on the device, send it again, then copy the log into your
  report.
- The iPhone Shortcut is called **Paperhue-Sync** everywhere, and **Sync
  now** runs it by that name.

## Download

- **Windows:** Paperhue.exe
- **Mac:** Paperhue-macOS.zip (macOS 14 or newer)
- **Android:** Paperhue-Android.apk
- **iPhone:** nothing to download. Open https://markhhm.github.io/ulani-epaper/
  in the Bluefy browser.

## Upgrading from 0.3.1

- Windows: replace Paperhue.exe with the new one.
- Android: install the new APK over the old one.
- Mac: replace Paperhue in Applications. macOS may ask once more the first
  time you open it.

Your pages and settings are kept.
